steps.message: Commit 3, Commit 4 and Commit 5 were a mistake — put the repo back to how it was right after I made Commit 2
I'll check whether this repo has Jujutsu set up before doing anything, since CLAUDE.md requires using `jj` rather than `git` for version control here.
